name: uma-club-bot-v3
description: WhatsApp bot for Uma Musume club leaders

scripts.restart: npm run stop && timeout /t 2 >nul && npm run start
scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('config.example.yaml','config.yaml');console.log('config.yaml created — edit it with your circle details')"
scripts.health: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/health | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(j.success?'✅ Bot is running':'❌ Bot is down');console.log('Time:',j.data?.timestamp)})"
scripts.db:backup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('data/bot.db')){const ts=new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');fs.copyFileSync('data/bot.db',\"data/bot.db.\"+ts);console.log('Backup created: data/bot.db.'+ts)}else{console.log('No database found')}"
scripts.fetch: ts-node -e "const{loadConfig}=require('./src/config');const{UmaMoeClient}=require('./src/api/uma-moe');const{saveSnapshot}=require('./src/data/snapshot');const config=loadConfig();const client=new UmaMoeClient();const now=new Date();client.fetchCircleData(config.circleId,now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()+1).then(s=>{const d=new Date(now.toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Jakarta'}));const ds=\"\"+d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');saveSnapshot(s,ds);console.log('Snapshot saved for '+ds)}).catch(e=>console.error('Fetch failed:',e.message))"
scripts.docker:stop: docker stop uma-bot && docker rm uma-bot
